ST.5 owns the heuristic models, so the Cohen–Lenstra–Martinet conjecture, Wang–Wood's prediction, Proposition 7.1 and the §7.2 comparison belong there. The route inherits the corrected statements: Lemma 2.1 with positive exponents and the index bound d^{r₁(K)+r₂(K)} (E7, E8), Lemma 3.13 with the weight |Aut_{O_F}(R)|⁻¹ (E10), and the conductor sum over all 𝔮 (E11). Tau Ceti GlobalNumberFields stops before the analytic continuation of Hecke L-functions, so no Tau Ceti layer owns these.
